layer1.name: SketchSync
layer1.description: Automatic version history for illustration files, with visual diffing between revisions. A well-researched problem with nothing yet known about reach, competition, or the founder's fit.
layer1.outcome_note: Synthetic fixture. Not a real company and not counted toward separation statistics.

layer2.pins: Uncovered dimensions. Every assumption maps to Problem Severity, so Market Access, Competitive Wedge and Founder Fit have no assumptions at all. They must report 50 with uncovered=true and a full-width band — a placeholder that the report can name as a gap, not an average nobody computed. The failure mode this guards against is a ledger that ignores three of four dimensions still producing a confident-looking composite.

assumptions.statement: At least 6 in 10 freelance illustrators billing over $50/hr have lost more than 2 hours of work to an overwritten file in the past year

falsification_criterion.observation: ask them to recall the last time they lost work to a file mistake
falsification_criterion.metric: count who lost 2+ hours in the past year

assumptions.statement: At least 3 in 10 illustration studios with 5 or more staff already pay for a file versioning tool

falsification_criterion.applies_to: illustration studios with 5 or more staff
falsification_criterion.observation: ask the studio lead to list their current file tooling and cost
